value.rationale: A natural observable pair becomes perfectly dependent, genuinely nonstable yet stable-marginal, or independent at the exact microscopic separation scale 1/(ng(0)). Infinite marginal means make covariance inapplicable, while the exact bivariate Laplace-overlap exponent gives a robust dependence measure. The all-separation strict profile and sharp universal coalescence/far-field constants quantify nontrivial crossover behavior and distinguish an entire distributional family from routine one-pole limits.
